# Long Distance Trail

> > Personal hiking blog documenting long-distance trails across Europe, including the GR5 (Lake Geneva to Nice), Cleveland Way, Alpine Pass Route, and wilderness treks in Finland, Norway, and Switzerland.

This site chronicles multi-day backpacking adventures with detailed trip reports, training logs, and gear insights. The author has published 'Alone Through the Alps: from Lake Geneva to Nice on the GR5' available on Amazon Kindle.

## Key Topics

- GR5 (Grande Randonnée 5)
- Cleveland Way
- Alpine Pass Route
- Long-distance hiking
- Backpacking and camping
- French Alps (Vanoise, Du Thabor)
- Switzerland hiking (Jungfrau, Lauterbrunnen)
- Finland wilderness (Kurjenrahka)
- Norway (Hardangervidda)
- Trip reports and trail guides
- Hiking gear testing (Thermarest)
- Training walks
- Book: Alone Through the Alps
- Pembrokeshire Coast Path
- West Highland Way

## Featured Trail Guides

- [2011 Cleveland Way](https://longdistancetrail.wordpress.com/trails/cleveland-way-2011): 175km Cleveland Way guide: UK moors and coastal trail complete report
- [2010 Hollands Kustpad](https://longdistancetrail.wordpress.com/trails/hollands-kustpad): 213km Dutch coastal trail guide: Hollands Kustpad trip report and tips
- [2012 Hardangervidda](https://longdistancetrail.wordpress.com/trails/2012-hardangervidda): 100km trek across Hardangervidda mountain plateau, Norway

- [GR5 – DAY13, to DU THABOR](https://longdistancetrail.wordpress.com/2013/12/13/gr5-day13-to-du-thabor): GR5 Day 13: 13km ascent to Du Thabor refuge, lightning storm encounter

- [GR5 – DAY16, to BRUNISSARD](https://longdistancetrail.wordpress.com/2013/12/16/gr5-day16-to-brunissard): GR5 Day 16: 25km from Vachette to Brunissard via Briancon
